documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Quarterly Results For Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026

analysis.summary: GNA Axles reported a 4% decline in net revenue to Rs 1,478.42 crore for FY 2025-26, impacted by US tariff-induced export headwinds, while domestic demand remained robust, particularly in tractors and commercial vehicles. Management improved operating efficiency, capacity utilization, and cost control, resulting in higher profitability with Profit After Tax rising 9.22% to Rs 116.99 crore. The company is actively diversifying its portfolio into Light Vehicles, Passenger Vehicles, and SUVs through GNA Mobility Limited, while scaling up renewable energy adoption such as rooftop solar capacity. Management reported a steady financial performance in 2024-25, driven by export growth and stable operational efficiency despite market uncertainty and flat domestic CV sales. The company achieved net revenue of ₹1,539.74 crore and an EBITDA of ₹210.61 crore, while incorporating a new wholly-owned subsidiary, GNA Mobility Limited, to expand into advanced motor vehicle components.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic tractor sales are expected to post a lower single-digit growth in the current year.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the Domestic Tractor Market is concerned we expect that the domestic sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth in this year as the Country expects a good monsoon this year which is expected to increase higher farm incomes and a lift in the rural economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for CVs is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.
demand_outlook.quote: With promising GDP growth outlook, incentives from government to improve productivity in both manufacturing and agriculture sectors, and continuing focus on infra, demand for CVs is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains cautiously optimistic about domestic demand.
demand_outlook.quote: We remain cautiously optimistic about domestic demand while keeping a close watch on geopolitical developments, interest rates, fuel prices and inflation.

capex_expansion.claim: Rooftop solar capacity was enhanced to 6 MW in 2025-26.
capex_expansion.quote: Enhanced our rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW

capex_expansion.claim: GNA Mobility Limited was incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary in 2025 to expand in automotive components.
capex_expansion.quote: In 2025, we incorporated GNA Mobility Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand our presence in automotive components.

margins_costs.claim: Optimization of capacity utilization and strict cost control continue to enhance efficiency and strengthen operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: Our emphasis on optimising capacity utilisation and maintaining strict cost control continues to enhance efficiency and strengthen operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: Targeted investments in advanced machining and automation improve precision, increase throughput, and enable scalable growth.
margins_costs.quote: At the same time, targeted investments in advanced machining and automation are improving precision, increasing throughput, and enabling scalable, future-ready growth.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for the year was 13.68%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 3,882,041 rear axle shafts in 2024-25.
The company sold 327,019 other shafts in 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: Total CSR expenditure for 2024-25 was ₹277.06 lakhs.

management_commitments.claim: The company is executing a 3 MW rooftop solar project to expand clean energy infrastructure.
management_commitments.quote: Continuing this trajectory, a 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution, reinforcing our dedication to expanding clean energy infrastructure.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
